verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official site explicitly says you can download Ubuntu Desktop and replace your current operating system, and that it is easy to install in place of Windows. Its documentation covers the replacement path: creating a bootable USB stick, an Install Ubuntu Desktop guide, step-by-step tutorials, and handling Windows-specific blockers such as BitLocker and Intel RST/AHCI. missing for 10: the actual content of the install guide (e.g., the erase-disk/replace option walkthrough), and independent hands-on reports of switching from another OS this way (one community comment only mentions a clean install in passing).
